summary: Tested 2 bug fixes: (1) Google Auth session persistence fix, (2) RevenueCat Paywall infinite spinner fix. Backend auth endpoints (401 handling, /api/auth/me, /api/auth/session) all pass and MongoDB index creation has no errors. Frontend: PIN lock, TrialGate, tab navigation, and Settings auth UI (loading -> unauthenticated -> Google redirect) all work correctly with NO false-login-success and NO crash - bug #1 is FIXED. However, bug #2 (paywall) is only PARTIALLY fixed: the infinite spinner is gone, but a NEW reproducible bug was found - the paywall frequently shows 'Subscription options are unavailable right now' instead of the promised mock/preview plan cards.

ui_bugs.issue: Paywall shows 'Subscription options are unavailable right now. Please try again later.' (testID paywall-unavailable) instead of the 3 mock plan cards + 'Preview mode' banner. Reproduced on 2 of 2 attempts including one where I waited 9s (past the 8s timeout). Root cause: Purchases.getOfferings() on the browser SDK does NOT always reject/hang - in this environment it often RESOLVES successfully but with an empty offering (RevenueCat SDK logs 'Could not find product data for product ids: pro.basic_monthly,pro.adfree_monthly,pro.premium_monthly... Empty offerings'). Since the promise resolves (doesn't throw/timeout), the try/catch fallback in useSubscriptionContext's offeringsQuery never triggers buildMockOfferings(), so 'packages' stays an empty array and paywall.tsx's `sorted.length === 0` branch renders the unavailable banner instead of plan cards.

action_items: In revenuecat.tsx offeringsQuery.queryFn, after a successful (non-throwing) Purchases.getOfferings() call, check if the resulting offering has zero availablePackages (or offering itself is undefined) and in that case ALSO fall back to buildMockOfferings(), not just on exception/timeout. Currently the fallback only triggers on catch, but the real SDK call can resolve successfully with an empty product list (confirmed via console log: 'Could not find product data for product ids... Empty offerings') which is a legitimate resolved (non-error) response in this sandboxed environment where web-billing test products aren't reachable.

Consider making this check flaky-safe: it was observed that behavior differs between the first and second SDK init within the same page load (first attempt threw 'Failed to fetch' triggering fallback correctly, second attempt resolved with empty packages and skipped fallback) - likely due to dev double-effect-invocation or SDK internal caching. The empty-packages fallback check will fix both cases.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx and settings.tsx: well structured, correctly handles web session_id extraction from hash/search, native cold-start + hot deep link, token storage via SecureStore/localStorage, and duplicate-exchange guard via processedSessionIds ref. No issues found.

server.py: get_authenticated_user correctly returns 401 (not 403) for missing/malformed/expired tokens via manual Header parsing + Depends. MongoDB indexes (users.email/user_id unique, session_token unique, TTL on expires_at) created on startup without errors.

revenuecat.tsx: withTimeout() helper correctly races Purchases.getOfferings()/getCustomerInfo()/logIn()/logOut() against an 8s timer, but does not handle the 'resolved-but-empty' case documented above - this is the one gap that causes the paywall-unavailable bug.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% - auth/settings fix fully verified working; paywall fix partially working (spinner gone, but plan cards intermittently/frequently fail to render)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded business/party data for navigation tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug #1 (Google Auth) is confirmed FIXED: Settings screen goes loading -> 'Sign in with Google' button (no false-login state), tapping it navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=... without any JS crash, PIN lock (1234) and TrialGate (14 days left, shown correctly) both regression-tested OK, and all 5 tabs (Dashboard/Parties/Billing/Reports/Settings) navigate without crashing. Bug #2 (Paywall) is only partially fixed - infinite spinner issue is resolved, but a new/related issue causes the paywall to show an 'unavailable' error banner instead of the 3 mock plan cards described in the fix. See action_items for the exact root cause and fix needed in revenuecat.tsx's offeringsQuery. Did not test the actual purchase/confirm modal flow since it requires identityReady (signed-in) state, and could not test real Google OAuth end-to-end (no test credentials for that, as expected per review request).
rca_of_issue: Purchases.getOfferings() in this sandboxed browser-mode SDK does not consistently throw/hang - sometimes it resolves successfully but with zero availablePackages because the web-billing test-store products (pro.basic_monthly etc.) are not resolvable, logged by the SDK itself as 'Could not find product data...Empty offerings.' The withTimeout()+catch fallback logic in revenuecat.tsx only builds mock offerings when the promise rejects or times out - it never inspects a successfully-resolved-but-empty result, so paywall.tsx ends up with an empty `packages` array and renders the 'unavailable' banner (sorted.length === 0 branch) instead of the intended preview-mode mock plans.
